newsitem.title: FRANCE: Havas no plans to lift Canal stake - report.
newsitem.headline: Havas no plans to lift Canal stake - report.

text.p: French communications group Havas has no plans to raise its stake in pay-television firm Canal Plus above 40 percent but intends to consolidate the business in its results, the Financial Times reported on Monday.

Havas was also willing to accept foreign investors as partners in Havas, Canal Plus and CanalSatellite as long as control remained with French investors, the paper reported, citing an interview with Havas chairman Pierre Dauzier.
Havas owns 38 percent of Canal Plus and Cie Generale des Eaux owns 30 percent of Havas after a restructuring of Havas's capital announced last week.
